test_render: test the TestRender class to verify the game renders rgb pixels correctly
test_unpack_rgb_image: test the Feature.unpack_rgb_image method to convert render data to rgb arrays
test_unpack_feature_layers: test the Feature.unpack method with SCREEN_FEATURES and MINIMAP_FEATURES to extract game observation layers
test_create_game: test controller.create_game and controller.join_game to set up a StarCraft II game session
test_observe_game: test controller.step and controller.observe to step through game frames and retrieve observations
